_doc: CIWATCH-1: the repositories whose default-branch Actions runs the system watches for red X's, and the rules it remediates by. Read by foundation/ciwatch.py, run by .github/workflows/ciwatch.yml. Every tenant in doctrine/tenant-repos.json is watched too (ciwatch.watched), so a new tenant needs no entry here. `queue_label` issues open more than `max_open_days` are filed as Q-AGED items (a queue that idles open is a failure no red run shows).
